title: Consumentensurplus
sourceEdition: Boek 2 - Kosten, opbrengsten, elasticiteit en surplus/edities/chat-2026
goals: Hoeveelheid bij een gegeven prijs berekenen
Vraaglijn en prijslijn tekenen met assen, eenheden en snijpunten
Gezamenlijk voordeel uitleggen en onderscheiden van betaling en evenwicht

startSupport.1: Retrieval: function substitution and intercepts (Book 1 §1.3.2); triangle area is mathematics prerequisite, not evidenced as previously taught economics. Overview offers p.74 as fallback. Refreshed fully in slides 6–11.
startSupport.2: Supported exploration of formal CS definition. Opening overview directs to p.72; identify maximum willingness versus actual payment. Return to start 1–2 after instruction on slide 15 before basis work. No opening worked answers.

teachingExamples.name: Filmavond
teachingExamples.purpose: One purchaser then a sum over distinct purchasers. No purchase gives zero CS.

teachingExamples.name: Theatermiddag
assumptions: Continuous linear demand model, distinct from discrete buyers
Enough tickets; all demanded tickets sold to highest willingness to pay
No supply function and no equilibrium computed
teachingExamples.purpose: Full calculation, coordinate construction, hatched region, triangle area, units and collective meaning. Does not solve assigned practice.
